guitar.modelsText: Fender Mustang / Fender Jaguar / Martin D-18E
guitar.notes: Confirmed — Kurt Cobain's Mustang, Jaguar, and the Martin D-18E from MTV Unplugged are all extremely well documented.

tone.summary: A clean signal chain utilizing compression and Chorus for the signature sound, followed by a Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) and cabinet to provide the necessary low-end clarity and slight grit.

rig.name: Nirvana - Come As You Are - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Tighten the attack and smooth out dynamics for a consistent sound.
Create the signature swirling, chorus-drenched sound.
Provide the subtle 'edge-of-breakup' grit without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used for its clean, slightly broken-up character, mimicking a light overdrive pedal.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean, solid-state or Fender-style amp tone.
Provide a bright, articulate sound suitable for the clean, mid-focused tone.
Fine-tune the low end and overall clarity of the clean tone.
blocks.gap: Used for precise tonal shaping, compensating for potential muddiness in the chorus/amp chain.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle sense of space without muddying the tight riff.
blocks.gap: A very light room reverb is used to give depth, but kept low to maintain tightness.

alternatives.reason: Could also work for subtle space.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the desired clean, articulate low end.

proposals.reason: Enhance clarity and articulation for the chorus/clean tone.
